name: Network, transparent protocol

policy._this_is_a_policy: Ce qu'il faut supposer quand l'appareil n'a rien dit, pas une mesure. Une fiche qui connaît son vrai chiffre l'emporte.

note: Third-party protocols that impose no ceiling of their own and pass whatever the endpoint accepts: Roon RAAT, Ravenna and AES67. The limit is the device and the link, not the protocol. For studio-derived designs this is the HIGH-capability input: Merging's NADAC takes 384 kHz and DSD256 here while its AES input stops at 96 kHz.
